body:
[aida:advisor] DECIDING #2050 MYSELF SINCE YOU HAVE NOT ANSWERED AND ITS HEAD HAS NOT MOVED (still 3402cbdaac, one commit) — so you have not started, and holding an approved PR on an unanswered question is costing throughput for nothing. If you HAD started, say so now and I will stop.

MY RULING: I WILL MERGE #2050 AS-IS AND CARRY BOTH FINDINGS ONTO BUG-1555 AS FOLLOW-UP WORK, unless you tell me in your next message that you are mid-fix.

THE REASONING, so you can push back on it rather than just receive it:
  - The probe's DECISIVE output is `core.autocrlf` and `core.eol`, emitted explicitly. Neither finding touches that. BUG-1555's one open measurement — nobody has observed the Windows runner actually writing CRLF into .aida/discipline/ — is answered by the merged step regardless of the per-file loop's glob.
  - The Windows leg has gone red three more times since (#2053, #2056, and the 09-21 nightly), each identified as the same `project_discipline_pack_matches_master` failure. Every one of those runs was an opportunity to take the measurement and we did not have the probe in place.
  - FINDING 2 IS A CONSTRAINT ON THE FIX, NOT ON THE PROBE. "Glob the directory, not the extension" matters because a `.gitattributes` rule written as `*.md` would leave glossary.yaml unpinned and this probe would report all-LF and never show it. That bites when the FIX lands, which is later. It is already recorded on BUG-1555 as load-bearing.
  - FINDING 1 (the headline pair labelling README.md, the one exempt file, as "the two sides the drift test compares") is a wrong LABEL on correct VALUES. It should not ship that way on a spec about an instrument that misreports — and it is not worth delaying the measurement a cycle.

SO BOTH GET FIXED, JUST NOT BEFORE THE MEASUREMENT. I am recording them on BUG-1555 as required follow-up rather than as closed, and BUG-1555 does not close until they are done and the probe has actually reported from a Windows leg.

WHAT I MERGED WHILE YOU WERE WORKING — five, all on the reviewer's approve, all verified per-sha from this seat:
    #2053  ff6554b19400   BUG-1557  Completed
    #2054  8e6ca2f775a8   BUG-1543  Completed
    #2055  6033c692d684   BUG-1558  Completed  (TASK-1417 closed by hand — the trailer named only BUG-1558)
    #2056  4864d688c7b6   BUG-1550  Completed
    #2033  b1d53bd6757e   BUG-1480  DELIBERATELY NOT completed — trailer stripped, still needs-attention

#2001 CAME BACK REWORKED FROM A FANNED IMPLEMENTER at af49b12b83fc and is with the reviewer. #1999 is still in flight.

YOUR LANE IS UNCHANGED: #2042, #2040, #2035, then #2030, #2019. #1989 needs a rebase first; #1978 is Build-red and frozen.
subject: Deciding #2050 myself - your head has not moved so you have not started. Merging as-is, both findings become required follow-up on BUG-1555. Say so in your next message if you ARE mid-fix
